content.raw:
Paediatric surgery deals with conditions requiring surgical care in infants, children and adolescents, from the prenatal period up to the age of 18. Treatment is tailored to the child's age and development, with open, endoscopic and laparoscopic techniques available. MedLuxLife coordinates consultations, surgery dates and aftercare at our partner hospital, so that families can focus on their child.

Treatments and services

Prenatal consultation

Surgical evaluation can begin before birth when a condition requiring surgery is identified during pregnancy.

Digestive system surgery

Diagnosis, treatment and follow-up of surgical conditions affecting the digestive tract in children.

Urinary tract surgery

Surgical care for conditions of the kidneys, bladder and urinary tract in childhood.

Chest surgery (non-cardiac)

Treatment of surgical conditions within the chest cavity, excluding the heart.

Open, endoscopic and laparoscopic techniques

Alongside conventional surgery, endoscopic and laparoscopic methods are used where suitable.

Day surgery

Many procedures allow same-day discharge, including inguinal hernia repair, hydrocele repair, treatment of undescended testicles, circumcision, catheter placement and endoscopic procedures.

Pain management

Specific pain-relief measures aim to keep children comfortable in hospital and after returning home.

Paediatric urology

In collaboration with the Urology department, surgical and endoscopic treatment of congenital anomalies and acquired problems such as stones and trauma.

Coordinated care

Work with other specialties for conditions such as congenital spinal cord defects and nocturnal enuresis (bedwetting).

Paediatric urology conditions

  • Cystic kidney diseases
  • Urinary tract obstructions and dilatations
  • Vesicoureteral reflux (urine flowing back from the bladder to the kidneys)
  • Bladder abnormalities
  • Penile abnormalities
  • Anorectal malformations
  • Urinary stones
  • Urological trauma

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous ultrasound or imaging reports
  • Prenatal scan reports, if the condition was identified before birth

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Paediatric Surgery consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
